rationale: Keep the current best bigram-rank-64 plus projection-only FP16 tail intact, but stop perturbing the whole model during late quant-aware training. This run only nudges the final decoder-side blocks plus the bigram tail toward the exact final int8 roundtrip path, aiming to preserve earlier-layer learning while improving the tensors that most directly drive final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact val_bpb.
title: Selective Quant-Aware Decoder Tail On Bigram64
